ko.hook: IBM Granite 4.2 오픈 소스 LLM의 데이터 전처리, 아키텍처 설계 및 훈련 파이프라인의 핵심 기술 공개

en.title: Inside Granite 4.2 LLMs: Architectural and Training Breakthroughs
en.hook: Deep dive into the architecture, data curation, and training pipeline of IBM's open-source Granite 4.2 model family.
key_takeaways: Detailed architectural modifications and training pipeline optimizations in Granite 4.2
Data filtering and curation strategies tailored for enterprise use cases
Fine-tuning and alignment techniques driving performance improvements
